role: The paywall screen (launch gate or from Settings/More) offering the 30-day free trial and the one-time unlock, restore, legal links and data export/deletion; plus PurchaseStatusView, the Settings row showing Owned or a link to the paywall.
types: PaywallView: struct (View) — paywall UI; isGate true when presented as the launch fullScreenCover (EmuquApp.swift), false from Settings (PaywallView.swift) and More (MoreMenuView.swift)
PaywallView.PaywallMessage: private enum — the one message the page's alert shows: .error / .purchase / .restore with its text
toplevel: Two #Preview blocks build PaywallView and PurchaseStatusView with AppDependencies.current.services.storeKitManager injected; preview-only. The `skipDebugButton` body is wrapped in #if DEBUG, so release builds render nothing there.

units.does: Computes the PaywallOffer (.trialAndUnlock/.unlockOnly/.unlocked) from storeKit.hasPurchasedProduct and PaywallGatePolicy.canStartTrial(storeKit.hasTrialTransaction, StoreKitManager.hasTrialStarted, storeKit.hasPermanentAccess).
Returns paywallStack wrapped by withPaywallChrome (background, dismiss lock, product load task, error alert).
Chooses layout by Dynamic Type: whole page in one ScrollView at accessibility sizes, otherwise the pinned layout (scrolling features with buttons pinned below).

branches.effect: true: ScrollView{wholePage} so everything scrolls together; false: pinnedLayout with bottomSection fixed under the scrolling content

units.does: VStack of a ScrollView around paywallContent and bottomSection with layoutPriority(1) so the buttons stay pinned.
VStack of paywallContent followed by bottomContent, used inside a single ScrollView at accessibility sizes.
Stacks header, features, recovery features, more features and pricing with 24pt horizontal / 40pt top / 24pt bottom padding.

Applies the paywall chrome: theme background, an onAppear debugLog, a .task that loads products, the Terms of Use / Privacy Policy / Your Data sheets (bound to showTermsOfUse / showPrivacyPolicy / showYourData; on the page so the two copies of the buttons ViewThatFits can hold do not each carry them), and the page's one alert, presenting pendingMessage (StoreKit error first, then a purchase notice, then what Restore found) with its title and an OK that clears the message it showed (dismiss), which presents the next. The alert binding's setter does nothing, so one OK tap clears one message. No swipe-dismiss control: the launch gate is a full-screen cover and Settings/More push it, so the gated user leaves through continueWithAccessButton.
units.entry: SwiftUI view-body evaluation (composed into PaywallView.body); .onAppear and .task fire on presentation; the alert's OK button

branches.effect: dismiss(shown) clears the message that alert presented; the binding setter, also written on dismissal, does nothing

The message to show now: storeKit.errorMessage as .error, else storeKit.purchaseNotice as .purchase, else restoreNotice as .restore, else nil.

Clears the field the shown message came from (storeKit.errorMessage, storeKit.purchaseNotice or restoreNotice), and only while it still holds that text: a field given a new text since keeps it, so it is shown next.
